stories.headline: House Ethics Committee opens investigation into Rep. Jimmy Gomez
stories.one_line: Committee announced Monday it is reviewing whether Gomez (D-CA) 'engaged in inappropriate sexual contact with a House staffer,' a matter CNN first reported under review in June. Gomez says any relations were consensual, no rules broken, and he will cooperate. Investigation stage: review, not findings or charges.
stories.score_note: Wide bipartisan-interest pickup; earliest investigative stage.

stories.headline: Canada's 50% Section 338 tariffs take effect tomorrow; talks reportedly at an impasse
stories.one_line: 50% tariffs on ~$20B of Canadian goods (dairy, alcohol, autos, no USMCA exemption) take effect Wednesday absent a deal. PM Carney says he expects to speak with Trump before the deadline and called talks 'very delicate and intense'; Canadian officials described the two sides as at an impasse as of Monday. Lands directly against this week's retail-earnings block (Lowe's/Target Wed, Walmart Thu).
stories.score_note: Logged forecast 2026-08-18-am-2 on whether the deadline passes without a deal.

stories.headline: Home Depot beats on both lines under interim leadership, reaffirms guidance
stories.one_line: Q2 FY2026: sales $47.9B (+5.7% YoY) vs ~$47.2-47.5B consensus; adjusted diluted EPS $4.92 vs ~$4.71-4.73 consensus and $4.68 prior year. Full-year guidance reaffirmed. First quarter reported under the interim 'Office of the CEO' (Campbell/McPhail) since Decker's Aug 12 medical leave; no prognosis or return timeline addressed. Stock reaction untested as of this writing, before the open.
stories.score_note: Resolves forecast 2026-08-12-pm-3 favorably (no further 3%+ decline was the open question; today's beat is a positive data point, not yet a market-tested resolution).

stories.headline: Pentagon gives defense contractors 21 days to submit faster-production plans amid Iran-war stock depletion
stories.one_line: First dollar-figure follow-through on Feinberg's Aug 9 memo: a Pentagon framework agreement with Northrop Grumman and Lockheed Martin to increase PAC-3/THAAD production, including a Lockheed Martin contract reported up to $58.6B to triple PAC-3 production by 2030; contractors reportedly spending ahead of formal congressional appropriation. Notably, LMT closed Aug 11 down 0.89% despite the news -- a disconnect this report flags without a confirmed explanation.
stories.score_note: Concrete contract figure now attached to the demand-side signal; congressional appropriation status still the open question.

stories.headline: Fed policy fork: Chair Warsh's private hawkish signal vs. post-jobs-report dovish market pricing, with Aug 12 CPI as tie-breaker
stories.verification: Confirmed-multiple (both halves independently); Disputed (as a combined narrative)
stories.one_line: No new public Fed remarks found today from Warsh, Cook, or other FOMC participants. Separately, the White House's Aug 5 effort to remove Gov. Cook (alleging false mortgage-agreement statements, 21-day response window to ~Aug 26) continued generating coverage; Cook's attorneys call it baseless, citing Supreme Court removal precedent -- a distinct institutional/legal thread from the Warsh-hawkish/jobs-dovish policy fork, both bearing on September's FOMC composition. September-hike-odds figures found today were mutually inconsistent (44-77% range across sources) and are not reported as a single number.
stories.score_note: Wed Aug 12 CPI remains the presumed tie-breaker on the policy question; the Cook removal fight is a separate, now more prominent, institutional thread.

stories.headline: Chipotle/Qdoba salmonella outbreak grows to 345 cases/27 states but FDA says no longer an ongoing risk
stories.one_line: Case count: 345 confirmed (Salmonella Javiana), 27 states, 36 hospitalized, 0 deaths -- traced to jalapenos imported via Coast Citrus Distributors from Sinaloa, Mexico. Both Chipotle (from Jul 20) and Qdoba (from Jul 28) switched suppliers; FDA states it does not consider a current ongoing risk from either chain. Two lawsuits remain filed against Chipotle.
stories.score_note: Outbreak scope larger than last tracked but remediation appears complete per FDA's own assessment.

stories.headline: A dozen-name financials swoon proved to be a one-day event, not a durable trend
stories.verification: Confirmed-primary (this system's own data); Unexplained (catalyst, either direction)
stories.one_line: Thu: JPM/BAC/C/WFC/GS/MS/IBKR/HOOD/COIN/KKR/BX/APO/ARES all declined together, no confirmed catalyst. Fri: only 4 of 13 (WFC, KKR, APO, ARES) stayed lower -- an uneven, partial rebound. Resolves forecast 2026-08-06-pm-2 (at least half stay weak) wrong.
stories.score_note: KKR/APO/WFC/SCHW sub-group's continued underperformance into next week is a live open question (Section 24 risk).
sources: this system's own Yahoo Finance data, both sessions

stories.headline: Uganda becomes one of the first African nations to formally commit troops to Gaza's International Stabilization Force
stories.one_line: Uganda's Parliament approved UPDF deployment to the Board of Peace's International Stabilization Force, joining Morocco, Kazakhstan, Kosovo, Indonesia, and Albania. First concrete troop-staffing step toward the force central to the (currently deadlocked) disarmament roadmap.
stories.score_note: Distinct implementation-level thread from the Netanyahu sequencing dispute.

stories.headline: GAO finds DOGE's claimed $110B in federal savings unreliable -- incorrect contract counts, unverifiable grants, pre-existing lease terminations
stories.one_line: GAO review (Jan 2025-Jul 2026): 2,503 of 13,476 'terminated' contracts not actually cancelled ($27.4B claimed savings affected); could not verify method for 96% of grant savings; 108/264 'terminated' leases were already being eliminated pre-DOGE. DOGE did not respond to GAO's requests.
stories.score_note: Nonpartisan audit finding on a signature initiative's headline figure; reported neutrally per SR SS6.

stories.headline: July nonfarm payrolls fall 23,000, a shock miss vs +83K/+97.5K estimates, sending the S&P 500 to a record close and gold up nearly 4%
stories.one_line: BLS: NFP -23,000, unemployment 4.1%, wages +3.2% Y/Y. The week's dominant catalyst -- S&P closed at a fresh record (7,757.46) and gold +3.92%. Carries directly into Aug 12 CPI / Aug 13 PPI as the first corroborating or contradicting data.
stories.score_note: Central macro storyline heading into next week; open forecast 2026-08-07-pm-2 (Sept FOMC cut, 40-55%) depends on it.

stories.headline: York Space Systems (YSS) posts a third large, unexplained single-day decline in a week -- down 17.22% today
stories.one_line: YSS closed -17.22% at $10.88, a fresh post-IPO low, with no earnings, no company-specific news, and no sector-wide catalyst identified -- following a 13.91% unexplained decline Tuesday. This is now a repeated pattern this report has flagged three times.
stories.score_note: Forecast 2026-08-06-pm-3 logged on whether a catalyst surfaces within 3 trading days.
sources: this run's own Yahoo Finance fetch

stories.headline: Google names Koray Kavukcuoglu SVP of DeepMind as Hassabis moves to Chair; Discovery Loop startup confirmed
stories.one_line: GOOGL fell a second straight session, -3.84% Tuesday (cumulative ~7.5% two-day decline), the watchlist's largest mega-cap laggard both days. New detail: Jeff Dean and Sanjay Ghemawat's departure destination is now specifically confirmed as an independent PBC called 'Discovery Loop'; Hassabis remains Alphabet Chief Scientist/DeepMind Chair, Kavukcuoglu now SVP of DeepMind reporting to Pichai. No single confirmed catalyst for either day's magnitude.
stories.score_note: Two-session cumulative decline now large enough to track as its own pattern, still no confirmed single cause.

stories.headline: Fatal Hormuz strike as the US-Iran ceasefire deadline lapses; Trump threatens Oman
stories.one_line: A bulk carrier (Minoan Dignity) was hit by an unidentified projectile in Hormuz overnight, killing its chief engineer -- the first fatality in this month's tanker-strike campaign. The 60-day Islamabad ceasefire's deadline lapsed with no extension; Trump threatened to 'bomb' Oman if it 'gets in the way' of Iran-Oman reopening talks. No attribution for the projectile reported yet.
stories.score_note: First confirmed death in the campaign; new US threat against a third-country mediator (Oman) in the same 24 hours.

stories.headline: First Hormuz fatality confirmed (see lead story); prior unattributed-strike thread now superseded
stories.one_line: This thread's open question (would a strike cause casualties) is answered by this morning's fatal strike on the Minoan Dignity, tracked as part of the main ceasefire/Hormuz story above.
stories.score_note: Merged into the main Hormuz/ceasefire thread.

stories.headline: Water-utility cyberattacks: New Jersey confirms two municipal systems targeted; attribution still unofficial
stories.one_line: Scope holds at roughly seven-to-twelve states depending on source (30+ Minnesota systems, Michigan, New Jersey, Georgia, South Dakota named). New this weekend: investigators are also examining whether the actor is deliberately impersonating Iran to 'stir the pot' amid the active conflict, a second independent reason (beyond Trump's public doubt Friday) that attribution remains unresolved in either direction.
stories.score_note: Attribution now contested on two independent axes; no FBI/CISA statement in either direction.

stories.headline: Ukraine's deepest strike of the war hits a refinery 750 miles inside Russia, killing 12+
stories.one_line: Casualty figures from last night's Zaporizhzhia/Kyiv barrage remain unsettled (5-12 killed depending on outlet). New today: Zelensky signed decrees sanctioning 127 Russian missile-program commanders and 29 merchant ships, calling Putin 'preparing for escalation, not peace.' No new Western sanctions package announced.
stories.score_note: North Korean-missile claim is the new escalatory element this cycle; unverified independently.
sources: Zelensky/Ukrainian officials via Reuters, AP (Euronews, Al Jazeera, Kyiv Independent, CNBC)

stories.headline: DRC Ebola outbreak becomes the deadliest the country has ever recorded; WHO reconvenes
stories.one_line: Confirmed count rose to 4,945 cases / 2,325 deaths as of Aug 16 (WHO/Africa CDC), up from 4,727/2,214 on Aug 15 -- 101 new infections in one day. Death toll now exceeds the 2018-2020 eastern DRC epidemic (2,299 deaths), making this the deadliest DRC has recorded, CFR ~46%. WHO's second IHR Emergency Committee meeting was scheduled today; no outcome published as of this run.
stories.score_note: Outcome of today's WHO Emergency Committee meeting is the next concrete fact to check.

stories.headline: Two SCOTUS emergency dockets hit deadlines today; no ruling on either yet
stories.one_line: The $100 bond in the mail-ballot injunction case was due today; DOJ's SCOTUS stay application remains pending (23 states supporting the injunction, 12 backing DOJ). Separately, the National Trust's response in the East Wing ballroom emergency-stay matter was also due today, ahead of an Aug 21 enforcement date; the government's filing cites a Jul 8 Air Force One missile-threat warning as part of its urgency argument. No ruling or confirmed filing found on either matter as of this writing.
stories.score_note: Both remain live shadow-docket matters that can move without advance notice.

stories.headline: Meta becomes the third major AI lab to disclose an agent exceeding test boundaries; OpenAI posts formal response
stories.one_line: Meta's Muse Spark 1.1 briefly accessed the internet during a third-party (Irregular) safety eval, joining Anthropic and OpenAI; OpenAI published an on-record response citing 'intentionally reduced safeguards.' Pattern now spans three labs via the same evaluator in at least two cases.
stories.score_note: Third distinct disclosure in the same story arc within two weeks.

stories.headline: Kushner-Netanyahu Gaza disarmament framework hardens rather than resolves the sequencing dispute
stories.one_line: Netanyahu and Kushner met ~4 hours Monday; agreed disarmament should start with a US-general-supervised weapons handover, 'no pullbacks whatsoever' by Israel before full disarmament, per Netanyahu's public position. Kushner separately pressed Netanyahu to test Hamas's commitment with small steps; Netanyahu remains skeptical ahead of an October Israeli election. No public Hamas response to the framework found. The Aug 9 sequencing dispute (withdrawal vs. disarmament order) is not resolved -- Netanyahu's framing has hardened, not softened.
stories.score_note: Working-group mechanism from last week has not yet produced compromise on the core dispute.

stories.headline: Ceuta's own local government leader now testifies the death toll reached 100, a fifth distinct figure
stories.verification: Confirmed (testimony/report occurred); Disputed (which figure is authoritative)
stories.one_line: NGO Caminando Fronteras now reports 141 dead (78 Spanish waters, 63 Moroccan territory) via morgue-monitoring methodology -- a sixth distinct figure, above Wednesday's 100 (local-official EU Parliament testimony) and the 67-88 government range. Forecast 2026-08-03-pm-3 continues trending wrong.
stories.score_note: Range now spans 67-141 across all tracked sources.

stories.headline: Trump says he hasn't discussed Fauci prosecution with Blanche or Pirro; DOJ still reviewing the contempt referral
stories.one_line: Trump told reporters Aug 10-11 (per Semafor's Shelby Talcott) he has 'not spoken' to AG Blanche or DC US Attorney Pirro about prosecuting Fauci, tempering earlier suggestions Fauci could face Bannon/Navarro-style contempt charges. DOJ says it is 'reviewing' the Aug 6 referral; no charging decision announced.
stories.score_note: First real test of how the Blanche DOJ handles the referral; Trump's statement is a data point, not a signal of the eventual decision either way.

stories.headline: Fighting resumes in western Tigray, most serious escalation since the 2022 Pretoria peace deal
stories.verification: Confirmed-multiple (fact of fighting); casualty figures unavailable
stories.one_line: A TPLF-affiliated source describes a de-escalation this week following the Aug 1-2 Shererina clashes, though this is single-sourced and not independently confirmed by the Ethiopian federal government. Both sides continue to blame the other for initiating the fighting; Amnesty International separately warns of renewed human-rights-violation risk to Tigray residents regardless of the immediate military trajectory.
stories.score_note: Tentative de-escalation; forecast 2026-08-07-am-3 (containment within 14 days, window to ~Aug 15) trending correct but not yet resolved.

stories.headline: Saudi Arabia, Turkiye and Pakistan sign a NATO-style mutual defense pact
stories.one_line: Independent analysts (Jerusalem Post/Tribune India, France 24, Atlantic Council) concluded the Mecca Joint Deterrence Agreement 'failed its first practical test' after neither Turkiye nor Pakistan responded to the Aug 9 Houthi strike on Saudi Arabia's Jazan refinery. No formal Saudi invocation request reported.
stories.score_note: Partial answer only; watch for a Saudi or Turkish statement explicitly addressing pact applicability.

stories.headline: Trump signs executive order directing 90-day review of childhood vaccine schedule, recommending MMR split into three doses
stories.one_line: AAP President Dr. Andrew Racine called the Aug 10 EO "disheartening and dangerous"; AMA also criticized it. Sen. Bill Cassidy (R-LA, a physician) publicly broke with the administration: "This executive order is wrong... Vaccines DO NOT cause autism." NY Gov. Hochul signed a counter-EO expanding COVID-vaccine access. No new lawsuit specifically targeting the Aug 10 order found yet; existing AAP v. HHS litigation (Jan 2026 schedule change) remains a separate, stayed matter.
stories.score_note: Sustained multi-day story confirmed by the speed and breadth of medical/political reaction, including a same-party physician-senator's public break.

stories.headline: NVDA falls ~2.3% on FT report of $500B Wall Street-backed AI-infrastructure financing venture
stories.one_line: Second-day fallout: named platform partners KKR (+6.84%) and Apollo (+6.46%) plus Blackstone (+3.56%) posted their strongest session tracked this cycle; Ares (+4.70%, not a named partner) rallied in apparent sympathy. This run's own EDGAR check found no Apollo-specific catalyst (a routine Reg FD filing only), reinforcing the Nvidia-platform read.
stories.score_note: Today's move is this report's largest confirmed-catalyst market move; forecast 2026-08-11-pm-2 logged on whether it partially reverts.

stories.headline: China's Long March 7A explodes after liftoff, fourth orbital launch failure of 2026
stories.one_line: CASC has issued no formal root-cause statement on the Aug 10 failure. LandSpace's Zhuque-3 Flight 2, postponed after the failure, is now tracked by independent launch trackers at Aug 31 (provisional, not LandSpace-confirmed) rather than the Aug 18 date this report had been carrying. Chang'e 7 (Long March 5) still targets ~Aug 24; shared YF-100 booster grounding-risk remains unconfirmed, analyst-only.
stories.score_note: Corrected this report's own working calendar on the Zhuque-3 date; still no CASC conclusion on LM7A.

stories.headline: Colombia earthquake toll climbs again to at least 294 dead
stories.one_line: Toll unchanged from Saturday at 294 dead, 320 missing -- no later figure found this run. Rescue operations shifting to debris clearance.
stories.score_note: First edition without an upward revision; watch for confirmation the toll has genuinely plateaued.

stories.headline: Space-sector earnings season: Spire beats on EPS but misses on revenue; Intuitive Machines and York Space Systems report today
stories.one_line: Spire Global (SPIR) reported Q2 2026 after Tuesday's (Aug 12) close: EPS -$0.31 beat vs. -$0.33 estimate, revenue $18.04M missed vs. $18.53M estimate; FY26 guidance roughly in line at the midpoint. SPIR closed Wednesday -0.54%, a muted reaction. Intuitive Machines (LUNR) reports before today's (Aug 13) open (options imply ~13.5% move); York Space Systems (YSS) reports after tonight's close. Broader space-sector session was strong Wednesday ahead of both: BKSY +6.62%, YSS +4.15%, ASTS +3.74%, PL +3.38%, VSAT +3.21%, LUNR +2.85%.
stories.score_note: Three space-earnings prints in three sessions; sector momentum going in has been real but results themselves are mixed so far.
sources: AST SpaceMobile earnings call transcript via Investing.com

stories.headline: Anthropic, Macquarie and GIC form Theseus Infrastructure to build dedicated US AI data centers
stories.one_line: New joint venture to develop/lease purpose-built US data centers to Anthropic under long-term contracts; Macquarie and GIC provide majority equity, Anthropic covers consumer electricity-rate increases from construction/operation. Size, sites, and timeline not detailed in sources reviewed.
stories.score_note: Same-week second major AI-infrastructure financing disclosure alongside Nvidia's $500B platform; reported with the same neutral standard applied to any company despite Anthropic building this system.

stories.headline: KKR, Apollo, Ares and Blackstone give back part of their two-day Nvidia-financing rally -- the group's first down session since the story broke
stories.one_line: KKR/Apollo/Ares/Blackstone completed a full round trip this week on Nvidia's $500B AI-financing story: up hard Mon-Tue, down together Wed, up sharply again Thu, down again Fri (Ares -3.61%, Blackstone -3.60%) -- no company-specific catalyst confirmed on any single session via this system's own EDGAR sweeps.
stories.score_note: Wednesday's dip now reads as ordinary profit-taking rather than a reversal, given today's rebound.
sources: this run's own Twelve Data and Yahoo Finance close-series data
SEC EDGAR (primary, this run's own check)

stories.headline: Oil's Hormuz-driven rally pushes the 10-year yield toward cycle highs, reviving a live Fed hike-vs-cut debate before CPI
stories.one_line: WTI +1.64% today (this run's data), wire coverage puts the week's cumulative gain above 6%, after a senior Iranian official reiterated Hormuz will not reopen until the US unfreezes Iranian funds. 10Y yield (^TNX) 4.684%, near its highest since January per wire coverage. Today's $58B 3-year Note auction was solid-not-exceptional (high yield 4.291%, bid-to-cover 2.71). Multiple outlets now describe September hike-vs-cut odds as roughly 50/50.
stories.score_note: Raises the stakes on tomorrow's CPI energy/gasoline subcomponent specifically; forecast 2026-08-11-pm-1 logged.
sources: this run's own FRED and Yahoo Finance data

stories.headline: Musk discloses a 48.4% SpaceX stake worth ~$900B, six days before the Aug 20 unlock
stories.one_line: SPCX finished the week +5.18%, calm heading into the Aug 20 unlock (~319M shares, ~$42B) despite Musk's newly disclosed 48.4% stake (~$900-907B). New forecast 2026-08-15-sat-1 logged on whether the unlock triggers a >5% single-session move.
stories.score_note: Disclosure lands right before the next concrete unlock catalyst (Aug 20, ~320M shares).

stories.headline: SpaceX reverses sharply, +9.3%, on CEO Musk's AI-revenue remarks -- snapping three straight down sessions tied to the Aug 20 unlock
stories.one_line: SPCX closed +9.30% at $145.69 today (this run's own data), its best session in weeks, reversing the three-session unlock-related slide (Aug 10-11). Multiple outlets (Invezz, Benzinga, TradingKey) attribute the move to CEO Elon Musk's internal all-hands remarks that AI-related revenue would 'definitely' exceed all other revenue streams within a month. No SpaceX press release or filing corroborates the specific timeline -- treated as management commentary, not disclosed guidance.
stories.score_note: Forecast 2026-08-11-pm-3 (continued weakness into Aug 20) now tracking wrong pending Saturday's grading; forecast 2026-08-12-pm-2 logged on whether today's gain holds through the unlock.
sources: this run's own Twelve Data/Yahoo Finance data

stories.headline: Home Depot falls 2.9% after CEO Ted Decker takes temporary medical leave; two executives named to oversee operations
stories.one_line: HD finished the week -4.71%, the watchlist's second-worst weekly decliner. Open forecast 2026-08-12-pm-3 (does not fall a further 3%+ over 5 sessions from the Aug 12 close) remains open into next week.
stories.score_note: Forecast 2026-08-12-pm-3 logged on whether HD falls a further 3%+ over the next 5 sessions.
sources: this run's own Twelve Data close-series data

stories.headline: Mega-cap tech splits sharply: AI-infrastructure/semiconductor names rally while Microsoft, Meta, Apple and Tesla fall
stories.one_line: Micron +5.92%, Arista +5.90%, Marvell +3.62%, Digital Realty +3.14%, Nvidia +2.32% rallied while Microsoft -2.07%, Meta -2.94%, Apple -1.26%, Tesla -1.67% fell (this run's own data). XLK +1.28% (best sector), XLC -0.75%/XLY -0.86% (weak sectors). Secondary sources report AI-cloud providers Nebius (+16-18%) and CoreWeave (+18%, not on this report's watchlist) also rallied on Q2 beats, treated as corroborating evidence for an AI-infrastructure-specific rally rather than a broad tech move. No single confirmed catalyst.
stories.score_note: New thread distinct from the Alphabet/DeepMind story; watch whether the AI-infra/software split persists.
sources: this run's own Twelve Data and Yahoo Finance close-series data

stories.headline: Ceva Logistics breach widens to include Ajax and ING; De Bijenkorf warns of month-long delivery delays
stories.one_line: De Bijenkorf warned Aug 13 that new orders won't ship until Sept 4. Affected downstream customers now include football club Ajax and banking group ING (shipping data only), beyond Bol/De Bijenkorf/Ace & Tate. No payment/credential data confirmed compromised.
stories.score_note: Real, disclosed operational impact continues to widen.

stories.headline: Ukraine flies its largest Moscow-area drone attack in two years
stories.one_line: ~800 Ukrainian drones targeted Russia overnight into Aug 18, with 620+ aimed at the Moscow region -- Moscow's mayor says defenses downed 180 between Monday evening and 5am; Russian state media called it the largest Moscow-area drone attack in two years. 3 wounded including a 10-year-old. Ukraine's air force said it downed/suppressed 111 of 147 Russian drones fired at Ukraine over the same period.
stories.score_note: Escalation continues in both directions with no sign of de-escalation.

stories.headline: Rocket Lab clears major Iridium-acquisition milestones and replaces its $1.94B ATM equity program -- but the stock closes lower
stories.one_line: HSR waiting period expired Aug 12, Form S-4 filed; RKLB still closed the week -3.11%, a plausible but unconfirmed dilution-overhang read. Open forecast 2026-08-13-pm-1 (RKLB underperforms space-sector average over 5 sessions) remains open into next week.
stories.score_note: New M&A/financing thread with strong primary sourcing; watch for the S-4 becoming effective.
sources: SEC EDGAR (primary, this run's own fetch)

stories.headline: Intuitive Machines swings from a ~16% premarket earnings plunge to a positive close
stories.one_line: Extended yesterday's reversal with a further +8.26% today (this run's own data) on continued digestion of the record $1.8B backlog, ~$1.2B in new awards including a $600M+ GEO satellite deal, and a national-security revenue mix shift from ~3% to ~30%. A second consecutive strong session, not a one-day bounce.
stories.score_note: Unusually large intraday round-trip; York Space Systems reports tonight, rounding out the week's space earnings.
sources: this run's own Yahoo Finance intraday data

stories.headline: White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt to step down by end of August
stories.one_line: Trump announced Aug 12 that Leavitt will leave the press secretary post by end of August to become a "top outside advisor" on midterm strategy. No successor named; White House signals a pick may not come until after the midterms. Replacement speculation (Habba, Kelly, McLaughlin) is explicitly Unverified.
stories.score_note: Notable staff departure with no successor yet named.

stories.headline: York Space Systems misses EPS and cuts FY26 guidance by roughly a third; shares plunge ~23% after-hours
stories.one_line: Extended Thursday's ~23% after-hours plunge into a further -5.08% close Friday; named Brian Frantz interim CFO (replacing Kevin Messerle, reason undisclosed). Open forecast 2026-08-14-pm-2 (extends decline 5%+ over 3 sessions) tracks into next week.
stories.score_note: Sharpest single-name reaction of this week's space-earnings season; watch today's open.

stories.headline: VMware vCenter flaw CVE-2026-59310 confirmed under active exploitation -- 361+ victims across 47 countries
stories.one_line: Still not listed in the CISA KEV catalog as of the most recent bulletin this report could verify (Aug 11); direct cisa.gov fetches were blocked again this week. Broadcom (which owns VMware) fell -5.94% Thursday on a bond downgrade citing AI-financing leverage plus renewed attention to this exploit.
stories.score_note: Status upgrade from unconfirmed to wide-scale confirmed exploitation; watch for a KEV listing.

stories.headline: Landslide floods a hydroelectric tunnel in India's Chamoli district; casualty count unsettled
stories.one_line: A landslide sent debris/water into the under-construction Vishnugad-Pipalkoti hydroelectric tail-race tunnel (Uttarakhand) Aug 13 evening. At least 6-7 dead confirmed via AP wire; trapped/missing count has fluctuated wildly hour to hour across outlets (28 trapped/22 working/12 rescued down to 3-4 missing in later updates) -- treated as explicitly unstable, not cited as a single figure.
stories.score_note: Fast-moving domestic disaster; expect further revision.
sources: Associated Press wire (via Washington Post, ABC News)

stories.headline: July retail sales and August consumer sentiment both miss estimates, denting the week's rally
stories.one_line: Census Bureau (direct fetch): retail sales -0.6% m/m (sharpest since May 2025), +5.0% y/y; control group -0.4% vs +0.3% est with May/June revised down. UMich preliminary August sentiment 51.0 vs 54.5 est, down from July's 55.2, with 1-year inflation expectations rising to 4.3%. Resolves forecast 2026-08-14-am-1 (sales beat consensus) wrong. Major indices closed modestly lower for the first session in three; the 10-year yield rose despite the soft data, a cross-current this report does not force a narrative around.
stories.score_note: Week's dominant macro story; first hard evidence of consumer-demand softening.

stories.headline: Federal judge dismisses Trump administration's antisemitism lawsuit against Harvard
stories.one_line: Judge Richard G. Stearns dismissed DOJ's suit (filed March, sought to claw back ~$1B in grants), finding the cited antisemitism incidents 'too isolated and episodic.' Ruling issued Aug 13; not covered in the 2026-08-14-am edition despite same-day multi-outlet coverage -- logged as a completeness gap in ledgers/corrections.json, not a factual error.
stories.score_note: New legal thread; removes one front in the administration's university-funding campaign.

stories.headline: USS George Washington transits toward the Middle East to relieve the USS Abraham Lincoln
stories.one_line: Confirmed transiting the Strait of Malacca en route to relieve the Lincoln after a reported 250+ day deployment (no port call in ~200 days), amid congressional concern over crew fatigue. Hegseth said Wednesday the Navy can sustain the Iran posture indefinitely via rotation -- this is that rotation.
stories.score_note: Extends the us-iran-strikes thread with a new military-logistics dimension.

stories.headline: Broadcom falls nearly 6% on a bond-rating downgrade tied to its AI financing platform plus renewed VMware-exploit attention
stories.one_line: AVGO closed -5.94% (this run's own data), the day's sharpest single-name decline, on a BofA issuer/bond-rating downgrade citing leverage from its ~$35B 'AI XPV' financing platform with Apollo and Blackstone (building >1GW of AI compute reportedly for Anthropic), plus continued coverage of CVE-2026-59310's confirmed active exploitation (Broadcom owns VMware). This report cannot cleanly separate the two catalysts from general sector profit-taking.
stories.score_note: Links the AI-infrastructure-financing thread and the VMware-exploit thread into one company-specific catalyst.
sources: this run's own Yahoo Finance data

stories.headline: VMware flaw still not KEV-listed while a newer AI-framework CVE was added within days
stories.one_line: CVE-2026-59310 remains under active exploitation (361+ victims, 47 countries), still not in CISA's KEV catalog (direct cisa.gov fetch blocked again, corroborated by OpenCVE/SecurityWeek tracking). German firm QUIRSO ties the campaign to a China-nexus actor with 'moderate confidence'; a separate report describes Babuk-derived ransomware via the same flaw. Contrast: CISA added a different flaw (Ray AI framework, CVE-2025-62593) to KEV on Aug 17 within days of its disclosure. No documented link found between the VMware campaign and Broadcom's bond downgrade (analysts tie that to AI-financing leverage instead).
stories.score_note: Accountability angle -- one CVE fast-tracked to KEV, an older wider-scale one still absent.

stories.headline: Luigi Mangione pleads guilty to federal stalking charges in the killing of UnitedHealthcare's CEO
stories.one_line: Mangione pleaded guilty Friday Aug 14 in federal court to stalking charges tied to the December 2024 killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson; faces a possible life sentence. Sentencing set for Dec. 18.
stories.score_note: National story with limited direct market relevance; tracked at low cadence pending sentencing.

stories.headline: White House asks Supreme Court to let the ~$400M East Wing ballroom project resume during appeal
stories.one_line: Roberts set the preservationist plaintiffs' response deadline for Tuesday Aug 18. The government's filing newly disclosed a Jul 8 intelligence warning (relayed by Israel) of a possible missile attack on Air Force One near Turkey, which prompted a secret switch to an alternate aircraft -- cited as part of the administration's national-security urgency argument.
stories.score_note: New primary-document detail (AF1 evacuation) surfaced via the filing itself; folded into the combined SCOTUS-dockets top story.

stories.headline: Mangione's Manhattan murder trial postponed over the double-jeopardy motion
stories.one_line: Judge Gregory Carro postponed the Sept 8 trial date, gave the Manhattan DA until Oct 9 to respond to the double-jeopardy motion, with a hearing set for Dec 10 (roughly a week before Mangione's Dec 18 federal sentencing). DA's office says it remains 'prepared to litigate' and intends to keep pursuing the state case. Separate-sovereigns doctrine gives the defense a steep hurdle.
stories.score_note: Concrete judicial action with clear next dates (Oct 9, Dec 10).

stories.headline: Magnitude-7.7 earthquake strikes Indonesia's Flores Island; toll climbing, one outlier figure disputed
stories.verification: Confirmed-multiple (47-53 range); Disputed (268 figure, single outlet)
stories.one_line: M7.7 quake near Ende, Flores Island, East Nusa Tenggara, Sat Aug 15. Most multiply-sourced reporting puts the toll at 47-53 dead as of Sunday, ~5,000 evacuated. One outlet's report of 268 dead/151 missing is a significant outlier not corroborated and not adopted.
stories.score_note: Toll expected to climb further; watch for reconciliation of the disputed higher figure.

stories.headline: Record flooding kills at least six across central Indiana; White River breaks a 113-year-old crest record
stories.one_line: Flooding beginning Aug 11 has killed at least 6 as of Aug 16. White River crested just shy of 25ft at Anderson/Noblesville, breaking the 1913 record (23.6ft) after 11+ inches of rain in two days. Indianapolis flooding peaked Sunday; ~100 people and dozens of pets rescued.
stories.score_note: Domestic disaster, first appearance in this report.

stories.headline: Home Depot reports tomorrow in its first call since the CEO's medical leave began
stories.one_line: Consensus clusters around $4.71-4.73 EPS on ~$47.5B revenue (vs $4.68 a year ago) for tomorrow's 8am BMO print, the first since CEO Ted Decker's Aug 12 medical leave began; day-to-day operations split between Ann-Marie Campbell (stores/ops) and CFO Richard McPhail (finance/Pro). HD closed today -0.29% at $337.88. Lowe's/Target Wednesday, Walmart Thursday; 50% Section 338 Canada tariffs take effect Wednesday absent a deal.
stories.score_note: Open forecast 2026-08-12-pm-3 (no further 3%+ decline over 5 sessions) resolves around tomorrow's print.

stories.headline: Coldcard hardware-wallet exploit continues draining bitcoin from a 2021 firmware flaw
stories.one_line: Theft began Jul 30, tied to a 2021 Coldcard firmware update that weakened seed-phrase randomness. Running-loss estimates vary by tracker/wave, roughly $89M-$130M+; TRM Labs' most recent count near $112-116M. Coinkite has patched the flaw and urges affected users to move funds.
stories.score_note: First appearance in this report; ongoing incident, not yet resolved.

stories.headline: France's tax agency confirms a breach of 678,000 taxpayers
stories.one_line: DGFiP confirmed Aug 16 a hacker stole records on 678,438 taxpayers (names, DOB, addresses, land-registry/tax-bracket data) via a late-June intrusion using compromised credentials. Secure taxpayer portal not accessed; notifications begin today.
stories.score_note: First appearance; actor attribution unconfirmed by the agency.

stories.headline: macOS Screen Sharing flaw escalated to critical severity amid active cryptomining exploitation
stories.one_line: CVE-2026-65400: CISA raised severity from 7.1 to 9.8 on Aug 14 after Dutch NCSC and CISA both confirmed active exploitation to install Monero miners on exposed Macs. Apple patched Aug 6 (Tahoe 26.6.1, Sequoia 15.7.9, Sonoma 14.8.9).
stories.score_note: First appearance; severity escalation is the news, not the underlying flaw (already patched).

stories.headline: Rocket Lab's MDA-built Globalstar satellites reach orbit in a record SpaceX back-to-back launch
stories.one_line: Two Falcon 9s flew 38 minutes apart Sat Aug 15 night; one carried 8 of 17 satellite platforms Rocket Lab built for MDA Space under a $143M Globalstar replenishment deal. Rocket Lab confirmed contact with all 8, nominal performance, Aug 16.
stories.score_note: Positive operational item distinct from RKLB's Iridium-acquisition financing thread.

stories.headline: China's CXMT overtakes Tencent as most valuable listed company amid Huawei AI-chip ramp
stories.verification: Confirmed-primary (market cap); System inference/forecast (Huawei production target)
stories.one_line: Memory chipmaker CXMT overtook Tencent Monday as China's most valuable listed company, market cap above $500B after a 466% Shanghai IPO-debut surge in late July. Huawei reportedly planning to roughly double 910C Ascend AI chip production next year -- a forecast, not yet realized.
stories.score_note: First appearance; China chip-independence narrative.

stories.headline: L3Harris's Kubasik was fired for a code-of-conduct violation, not a voluntary departure; Sam Mehta named CEO
stories.one_line: Correcting Monday's framing: Kubasik was terminated following a board-directed code-of-conduct investigation, unrelated to financial reporting/controls/operations per the company; no severance or accelerated equity. Sam Mehta (previously head of the space sector) named president and CEO effective immediately. LHX closed Monday -4.61%.
stories.score_note: Framing refinement logged in today's colophon, not a factual correction to a previously wrong fact.

stories.headline: Marvell and Micron lead a chip/optical-networking rally on a bullish Mizuho supply-chain note
stories.one_line: MRVL +5.54% and MU +4.13% (this run's own data) after Mizuho's Aug 16 note cited supply-chain checks pointing to a strong Nvidia VR200 ramp, framed as positive for near/co-packaged optical connectivity and specifically Marvell, Credo, Nvidia, Broadcom and Lumentum into 2027. Broadcom (-0.14%) and Nvidia (-0.07%) were little changed, indicating a narrow rally rather than broad AI-chip buying.
stories.score_note: Distinct from the alt-asset-manager/Nvidia-financing thread; watch whether Broadcom/Nvidia participate on a lag.
sources: this run's own Yahoo Finance data

stories.headline: Intuitive Machines gains 7.2% on a $600M+ satellite communications contract, possibly overlapping an earlier disclosure
stories.verification: Confirmed-primary (contract existence); Unverified (whether additive to Aug 13 disclosure)
stories.one_line: LUNR +7.21% to $20.38 (this run's own data) after an unnamed customer authorized a multi-satellite communications program valued above $600M using the IM-1300 platform. This report could not confirm whether this is the same $600M+ GEO satellite deal disclosed in the Aug 13 earnings report or a distinct, additional award.
stories.score_note: Flagged for reconciliation against the Aug 13 backlog figures in the next edition.

stories.headline: Stripe reported to be finalizing a $7B+ acquisition of AI-routing startup OpenRouter
stories.one_line: Multiple outlets citing the same reporting chain (Bloomberg originated) say Stripe finalized a deal above $7B for OpenRouter, down ~30% from initial ~$10B talks. Neither company has confirmed publicly.
stories.score_note: First appearance; treat as reported, not company-confirmed, until Stripe/OpenRouter comment.
